articles.title: Arctic Sea Ice Is Shrinking and Getting Thinner
articles.summary: Satellites show Arctic sea ice is shrinking in summer and winter and getting thinner.

articles.title: Scientists Listen to Roars to Help Protect Wild Animals
articles.summary: Scientists are recording lion and leopard roars to track and protect wild animals.

articles.title: The Brain Still Listens to Stories During Surgery Sleep
articles.summary: Scientists found the brain can still recognize words and predict what comes next, even under anesthesia.
